If the topic is enabled for historical query and AMPS has a
transaction log that covers the topic, AMPS returns the saved
state of the SOW as of that bookmark and starts a bookmark
subscription at a point in the transaction log immediately after
the point at which the SOW state was saved.
In other words, if the granularity of the historical SOW
preserves the state of the SOW at 11:30:10 AM and 11:30:50
AM, a request for a bookmark at 11:30:20 AM will provide the
SOW state as of 11:30:10 AM, and begin the replay
immediately after that SOW state. This ensures no messages
are missed, but means that the subscription may begin before
the bookmark.
